description: This file is a shell script used for building, testing, and generating coverage reports for the entservices-appgateway-34 project. It performs environment setup, dependency installation, repository checkouts, patch applications, targeted build configurations, and runs specific tests with coverage analysis, as well as staging plugin libraries and configuration files.

methods.name: have_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the system PATH.

methods.name: is_root
methods.description: Checks if the script is running as root user.

methods.name: apt_can_run
methods.description: Determines if apt-get can be executed (user has root or sudo).

methods.name: apt_get
methods.description: Runs apt-get with non-interactive and automatic options.

methods.name: run_best_effort
methods.description: Runs a command and logs a warning if it fails, but does not stop execution.

methods.name: ensure_git_checkout_ref
methods.description: Checks out a specific git ref/tag/branch in a repository.

methods.name: ensure_repo_clone_and_checkout
methods.description: Clones a repository if not present or reclones if requested, then checks out a specific ref.

methods.name: apply_patch_dir
methods.description: Applies a patch file to a repository directory in an idempotent manner.

methods.name: build_dir_configured
methods.description: Checks if a build directory has been configured by CMake.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_install
methods.description: Configures, builds, and installs a project using CMake with full install steps.

methods.name: cmake_configure_build_noinstall
methods.description: Configures and builds a project using CMake without installation (useful for testing and coverage only builds).

methods.name: stage_all_plugins_from_dir_best_effort
methods.description: Copies plugin shared libraries (*.so) from a source directory to the staging directory, best effort.
